standard-dialogue.player: Hey there. What brings you here?

standard-dialogue.npc: I am researching the Dark Altar. Many of our forefathers spent their lives studying it, though much knowledge was lost over the generations.
I believe some of their writings would have been stored in this Library, though the Librarian seems unable to help me locate any.

standard-dialogue.player: Well good luck in your search.

historical-dialogue-before-20-favour.npc: Excuse me, I do not believe we have any business.

historical-dialogue-before-20-favour.text: You do not have enough Arceuus favour. Current favour: [0.0% - 19.9%]  - Required: 20.0%

historical-dialogue-after-20-favour-init.npc: I wonder, traveller... Could you assist me?

steps.npc: I am researching the Dark Altar. Many of our forefathers spent their lives studying it, though much knowledge was lost over the generations.
I believe many of their writings would have been stored in this Library, though the Librarian seems unable to help me locate any.
In your exploration of the Library, if you should happen to find any manuscripts of this nature, please bring them to me, and you will gain my gratitude.

historical-dialogue-after-20-favour-talk.text: If the player does not have any Dark manuscripts in their inventory:

steps.npc: Do you have any dark manuscripts for me, traveller?
Our forefathers studied the Dark Altar for generations. I am sure their knowledge is stored in this Library somewhere. It is a shame that the Librarian seems unable to help me.

historical-dialogue-after-20-favour-talk.text: If the player has Dark manuscripts in their inventory:

steps.text: If the player has only one Dark manuscript in their inventory:
You hand over the dark manuscript and receive a book in return.
If the player has multiple Dark manuscripts in their inventory:
You hand over the dark manuscripts and receive some books in return.

steps.npc: Thank you very much. In return, I have given you some knowledge that you may perhaps appreciate.
